# The POP3 size log reports measurements without identifying the failed store limit

The client logs free space, requested bytes and folder size when warnIfLocalFileTooBig reports failure. That native helper delegates to the selected store and distinguishes file-too-big from other space failures. The new Too big text therefore adds diagnostic context without proving a full physical disk or repairing the intermittent issue. The caller still catches, logs and requests failed completion. The accepted message retains three concatenated template strings with spaces separating the measurements; that is the checked local message form.

Scope: POP3 local-growth diagnostic scope.
